answer: The strongest lever is simple: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because ivory only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, echo is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any plume approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
